name: Fellow
description: Fellow lets agents search meetings and read their summaries, transcripts, and action items in the signed-in Fellow workspace. A workspace admin must turn on the MCP server, and each user signs in through the browser.

prompts.text: Which action items from my meetings this week are still open?
Summarize the last product review meeting.
Prepare talking points for my next one-on-one from our past meetings.

apps.name: Fellow
apps.description: Meeting summaries, transcripts, and action items, over Fellow's MCP server with browser sign-in.
